ne_sos — Nebraska Secretary of State unofficial results (electionresults.nebraska.gov)
Fetched 2026-10-27 with a descriptive User-Agent; the site is showing the 2026 general
before any votes are counted, so every vote count here is 0.

  https://electionresults.nebraska.gov/resultsSW.aspx?type=SW&map=CTY   -> sw.html
      (US Senator, Governor and Lt. Governor, Auditor of Public Accounts)
  https://electionresults.nebraska.gov/resultsSW.aspx?type=CG&map=DIST   -> cg.html
      (US House districts 01, 02, 03)
  https://electionresults.nebraska.gov/resultsSW.aspx?type=LD&map=DIST   -> ld.html
      (Legislature districts 02, 04)
  https://electionresults.nebraska.gov/resultsSW.aspx?type=SE&map=DIST   -> se.html
      (State Board of Education district 05)

Trimmed by keeping only the listed contest blocks: each `<div class="wrapper-inside
wrapper-border">` block is verbatim from the live page (byte-for-byte, including the
Export/Map widgets), everything else on the page (nav, header, other contests) is
dropped and replaced by a minimal html shell.
